premises: B2 phase at cell boundaries forms an interwoven hexagonal net in L-PBF Al0.5CrCoFeNi
Dislocation channels (nano-bridges) exist between B2 phase on cell boundaries connecting fcc cells
These nano-bridges act as highways for dislocation movement away from a crack tip
